remarks: Sophisticated living can be yours in this sunny 2-bedroom, 2-bath flat featuring high ceilings, walls of noise-reducing windows & modern design for easy living & entertaining. This fourth-floor corner unit is filled w/sunlight & showcases sunset views you can enjoy relaxing at home w/family & friends. In fact, the open plan living & dining room has a ceiling that measures nearly 11-feet high & the area boasts expansive windows that span the walls & create double aspect views that fill the rooms w/so much natural light! Designer gourmet kitchen is perfect for the serious home chef. There is abundant sleek white cabinetry, Wolf gas range, SubZero refrigerator, large undermounted sink & Bosch dishwasher ... while expansive granite countertops provide lots of workspace + breakfast bar for casual dining. Primary bedroom has custom outfitted walk-in closet & handsome en suite w/double sink vanity & WI shower, while 2nd bedroom is roomy w/outfitted double closet. Large 2nd bathroom has tub w/shower & both bathrms have lustrous modern vanities. This lovely unit has gas cooking, nest thermostat, heat+CAC cooling water incl'd in common charge+2-deeded garage spots-Feature sheet tells all. The building has a well-equipped gym, inviting Community Room, temp-controlled wine cellar & SELLER WILL PAY $13,248 roof/paint assessment! Conv location nr shops-mins to Scalzi Park for tennis & to Stamford's vibrant downtown. Now's the time to live the easy lifestyle you deserve in true splendor!
